titulo: Práctica extra de Inglés — Responder con evidencia del texto: How Can We Reduce Household Waste?

temas.nombre: Evidence: How does trash harm people, plants, and animals? (pp. 257-258)
temas.explicacion:
Collaborative Discussion · Question 1 (literal del libro): “Review pages 257–258. What are some of the ways that trash harms people, plants, and animals?”

Effects of Pollution from Paper, Plastic, Metal, and Glass (texto literal):
7 — “When products are thrown away, they often end up in landfills. These are places where trash is buried in the ground. Other trash items are burned in incinerators.”
8 — “Landfills and incinerators cause problems for our planet. For instance, when paper rots in landfills or burns in incinerators, it sends out greenhouse gases. These gases trap heat in Earth’s atmosphere. Greenhouse gases are important because they make our planet warm enough for life. But too much greenhouse gas leads to higher temperatures.”
9 — “Things made of plastic take a long time to decompose, or break down into smaller bits. So these products stay as they are for hundreds of years and take up space in landfills. They often leach, or leak, dangerous chemicals into the environment. When plastic is burned in incinerators, it releases chemicals into the air. Many of these chemicals are harmful to people and plants.”
10 — “Sometimes trash does not even make it into landfills or incinerators. Many household items end up as litter in parks, forests, rivers, lakes, and oceans. The litter problem is so big that vast sections of the ocean are covered with bits of plastic.”
11 — “All that litter puts toxic chemicals into the land, water, and air. This can make plants and animals, including humans, very sick. Animals can also get trapped in plastic trash and starve. Sometimes animals eat small pieces of trash because they think it is food. These animals often get sick and die as a result.”

Caption: “This water sample from the ocean contains hundreds of pieces of plastic.”
temas.microleccion:
Ejemplo con OTRO texto (no es del libro): «Smoke from forest fires fills the air with tiny pieces of ash. When people breathe this air, they can cough and have trouble breathing. Birds leave the area because their trees burn.»
Pregunta: How does smoke harm people and animals?
Paso 1 — Busco en el texto lo que les pasa a las personas: «they can cough and have trouble breathing».
Paso 2 — Busco lo que les pasa a los animales: «Birds leave the area because their trees burn».
Paso 3 — Escribo oraciones completas citando el texto: Smoke harms people and animals. The text says that people can cough and have trouble breathing. It also says that birds leave the area because their trees burn.

temas.nombre: Evidence: Why is food wasted in the United States? (p. 261)
temas.explicacion:
Collaborative Discussion · Question 2 (literal del libro): “Reread page 261. What are some reasons that food is wasted in the United States each year?”

Effects of Food Waste and Yard Waste Pollution (texto literal):
16 — “In the United States, farmers produce more than 590 billion pounds (268 billion kg) of food every year. But Americans waste between one-quarter and one-half of that food. Farmers sometimes let fruits and vegetables rot in fields. They often do this when the food is not an ideal shape or color, because this makes it harder to sell.”
17 — “Stores throw away a lot of food, too. They want customers to have plenty of choices. So, they stock more food than they plan to sell. They also get rid of many foods that do not look perfect.”
18 — “People waste a lot of food at home as well. Families often fail to use their food before it goes bad. And many people buy more food than they can use. When food and yard waste ends up in landfills, it rots. This creates methane, a powerful greenhouse gas.”

Caption: “These tomatoes have skin cracks, so the farmer left them in the field.”

Tres grupos desperdician comida: farmers (agricultores), stores (tiendas) y families / people at home (las familias en la casa).
temas.microleccion:
Ejemplo con OTRO texto (no es del libro): «Many schools waste paper. Teachers often print more copies than they need. Students throw away notebooks that still have empty pages.»
Pregunta: What are some reasons that paper is wasted in schools?
Paso 1 — Busco las razones y QUIÉN desperdicia: los teachers «print more copies than they need»; los students «throw away notebooks that still have empty pages».
Paso 2 — Escribo oraciones completas con la evidencia: Paper is wasted in schools for two reasons. First, the text says that teachers print more copies than they need. Second, students throw away notebooks that still have empty pages.

temas.nombre: Evidence: What can people do to reduce household waste?
temas.explicacion:
Collaborative Discussion · Question 3 (literal del libro): “How can people reduce the amount of trash they create?”
Write a Response · Prompt (literal): “Respond to the Text In How Can We Reduce Household Waste?, you learned how people’s trash affects our planet. Think about the things people can do to reduce household waste. What actions can they take? How can these actions help the planet? Cite evidence from the text to support your response.”
Evidence: “List ideas from How Can We Reduce Household Waste? that tell what people can do to help reduce household waste.”

What Can We Do? (texto literal):
12 — “You can reduce the amount of trash you create. Start by buying only what you need. When you do buy something, look for items made from recycled materials. Also, look for products that have little or no packaging. One good choice is buying whole fruits and vegetables instead of those in boxes or bags. When shopping, bring reusable bags instead of using disposable plastic bags.”
13 — “When you are ready to get rid of something, look for ways to reuse it. For example, an old shoe box can become a storage bin. If you do not want an item that is in good condition, give it to someone else. If no one wants it, try to recycle it. If you have to throw it out, dispose of it properly so it does not become litter.”

Solutions to Food Waste and Yard Waste Pollution (literal):
19 — “How can you help? Take only the food that you plan to eat. And try not to be too picky. For instance, cut a bruise out of an apple and eat the rest instead of throwing away the whole apple.”
21 — “People can generate less yard waste by keeping leaves and grass clippings on the lawn. […] People can shred leaves and grass clippings to make mulch.”
22 — “You can also turn food and yard waste into dirt. This process is called composting. […] Over time, these materials will naturally decay and turn into dirt. Then you can use the dirt to plant a garden!”

Solutions to E-Waste Pollution (literal):
26 — “You can reduce harmful e-waste. First, do not get rid of electronics that still work. Second, when you do get rid of electronics, look for recycling programs at local stores and government offices.”

Reduce, Reuse, Recycle (literal):
27 — “The less we buy, the less trash we produce.”
28 — “So the next time you are at the store, think about what you really need. If you can live without something, consider leaving it on the shelf.”
29 — “When you do buy something, try to use it until it wears out. And if you do not need it anymore, give it to someone who will use it. That way, it will not go to a landfill.”

How these actions help the planet (párrafo 4, literal): “When we recycle and reuse waste, we keep these materials out of landfills. This helps clean the land, air, and water. It also improves our health.”
temas.microleccion:
Ejemplo con OTRO texto (no es del libro): «You can save water at home. Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth. Take short showers instead of long baths. Saving water helps rivers and lakes stay full for fish and plants.»
Pregunta: What can people do to save water, and how does it help the planet?
Paso 1 — Acciones (evidencia): «Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth», «Take short showers».
Paso 2 — Cómo ayuda: «helps rivers and lakes stay full for fish and plants».
Paso 3 — Respuesta en oraciones completas: People can save water at home. The text says we should turn off the tap while we brush our teeth and take short showers. These actions help the planet because rivers and lakes stay full for fish and plants.

temas.nombre: Make sure your response: complete sentences and evidence from the text
temas.explicacion:
Write a Response · Write (literal del libro): “Now write your response in a paragraph.”

Make sure your response
  • answers the questions.
  • uses evidence from the text.
  • describes what people can do to reduce household waste.
  • explains how reducing waste helps care for the planet.
  • is written in complete sentences.
Ayuda para escribir (no es texto del libro, son frases útiles para citar evidencia):
  • Complete sentence = empieza con mayúscula, tiene sujeto y verbo, y termina con punto. «Toxic chemicals.» NO es una oración completa; «Litter puts toxic chemicals into the water.» SÍ.
  • Evidence from the text = lo que dice el texto, no tu opinión. Frases para citar: The text says… · According to the text, … · In paragraph 11, the author says…
  • Orden de un párrafo de respuesta: 1) answer the question (repetí la pregunta en tu respuesta), 2) give evidence from the text, 3) explain how it helps care for the planet.
temas.microleccion:
Ejemplo con OTRA pregunta (no es del libro): Why should we turn off the lights? Texto: «Turning off the lights saves energy. Power plants burn less coal when people use less electricity.»
❌ «Energy.» → no es oración completa y no tiene evidencia.
❌ «I like the dark.» → es opinión, no evidencia.
✅ Paso 1 (answer): We should turn off the lights to save energy. Paso 2 (evidence): According to the text, power plants burn less coal when people use less electricity. Paso 3 (explain): This helps care for the planet because the air stays cleaner.
